name: godot
description: Godot 4 development with a closed feedback loop: run the game, look at it, drive it, read its real errors — plus headless scene authoring and game-design skills for 2D and 3D.

godot.description: Drive a running Godot 4 game — screenshot, scene tree, node get/set/call, expression eval, input injection, frame stepping, error logs, headless check and scene authoring.
